database: PostgreSQL 16 on a disposable Docker bridge; host port bound to loopback only
external_network_access: Docker bridge egress was available; the check made no external requests
checks: operator CLI lists tenant-transfer history
owner and explicitly shared tenant-qualified grants set database-derived context
database uniqueness guard prevents ambiguous tenant-grant context
legacy NULL-tenant grants are denied and previous local context is cleared
transaction-local tenant context resets at commit on the reused connection
report-review owner and shared-grant queries set context before protected reads on one connection
report-review reads clear tenant context after transaction rollback
legacy location-only report-review grants are denied before query execution
Field Collector owner queue and shared-detail reads set same-connection tenant context
Field Collector list, detail, and audit reads clear tenant context after rollback
legacy location-only Field Collector grants are denied before collection query execution
multiple disposition grants set context only when they resolve to the same tenant
individually valid grants from different tenants are denied with context cleared
pending transfer preserves owner, shares, and all existing grants
self-approval and non-admin target approval are denied
changed owner-relationship snapshot blocks acceptance and can be cancelled
conflicting and unverified locations cannot enter a transfer
injected post-mutation failure rolls back owner, verification, grants, and shares
acceptance atomically transfers owner links and revokes owner, partner, and legacy access
new owner receives access only after a separate tenant-qualified grant
transfer request evidence cannot be updated, deleted, or truncated
migration 390 idempotent replay preserves accepted transfer and grants
scope_limit: Synthetic disposable data only; no archive, pilot, candidate, or production records were used. Acceptance verifies database, local CLI, report-review and Field Collector review queue/detail/disposition-context wiring, not legal land title, human retention/erasure outcomes, other Gateway routes, worker isolation, direct-database boundaries, or RLS.
